name: CloudCLI
profile: Our setup: a self-hosted CloudCLI instance used as the single web workspace for several agent CLIs (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini, OpenCode) and non-Anthropic models through a provider router, used from a desktop browser and a phone. What matters most: reliable sessions (websocket reconnect, live streaming of text and tool calls, visible subagent runs), every agent CLI and provider in one window, session history that is easy to navigate, artifacts and file previews in the browser, and headless install and auth of the CLIs. Upstream releases are merged into our fork every version, so small self-contained fixes matter more than sweeping refactors. No telemetry, no vendor lock-in.

areas.providers_cli: Agent provider integrations and CLI adapters: Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini/Antigravity, OpenCode, Qwen; CLI auth, model lists, runtime wrapper, provider settings
areas.sessions_streaming: Sessions and the chat stream: session list/history/transcripts, resume and fork, websockets, live output, subagent runs and completion, mobile reconnect
areas.permissions_auth: Users, login, permissions, guest and shared access, tokens and stored credentials
areas.files_git: File tree and explorer, file editing from the chat, git panel, diffs, branches and worktrees
areas.tasks_board: Task board, TaskMaster, session tasks and statuses, notes, scheduled messages
areas.artifacts: Artifacts: browser previews, shared links and passwords, downloads, attached files, retention/TTL, assets
areas.ui_ux: Web UI: layout, themes, components, mobile viewport, styling and keyboard shortcuts
areas.deploy_desktop: Install, hosting, Docker, self-host, desktop (Electron) builds, service exposure (Caddy/nginx), updates and release tooling
areas.mcp_plugins: MCP servers, plugins and extension points, project and workspace handling
